sdk.use: Independent opt-in simulation tooling; no cloned source imports/scripts.
sdk.renderer: Raw mjr_readPixels RGB HWC bottom-up, source macros opengl; native CGL offscreen context can avoid all windows. SDK Python Renderer adds flipud and cannot be treated as raw readout.
physics_integration_order: set new goal only when first substep of policy action
recompute OSC torque and gripper action every substep

state.rotation: robot0_right_hand BODY quaternion wxyz->xyzw -> source axis-angle, radians; preserve quaternion sign, angles >pi are valid
state.controller_rotation: gripper0_grip_site matrix, different from state body orientation
state.fingers: qpos of gripper0_finger_joint1 and gripper0_finger_joint2, metres
state.conversion: source clamps w[-1,1], den=sqrt(1-w*w); returns zero only if den isclose(0,abs_tol0), otherwise xyz*2*acos(w)/den; do not canonicalize to w>=0

action.network_decode: Reuse qualified ge_decode original q01/q99 -> first16x7, gripper -sign(2*g-1).
action.translation: World-frame position increment, metres; NOT velocity or absolute target. Reanchor goal position at current EEF on each policy action.
action.orientation: World-frame axis-angle increment in radians; goalR=R(delta)@current_site_R when any orientation component is nonzero. An exactly zero orientation delta retains previous goal orientation.

osc.numeric_profile: Source NumPy float64 simulator/controller quantities; intended Coax f64 CPU controller, not neural BF16/F32 profile.
osc.jacobian: 6x7 world grip-site translational then rotational Jacobian
osc.task_inertia: np.linalg.pinv(J M^-1 J.T), separately position3/orientation3 and full6; no explicit 1e-5 cutoff in this pin. NumPy default rcond=1e-15.
osc.nullspace: Jbar=M^-1 J.T Lambda_full; N=I-Jbar J; tau_null=N.T M [10*(q_initial-q)-2sqrt(10)*qvel].
osc.torques: J.T concat(Lambda_pos*(kp*poserror-kd*linearvel),Lambda_ori*(kp*orierror-kd*angularvel)) + qfrc_bias + tau_null, clipped at actuator limits

gripper.hidden_reset_state: HDF5 flattened state lacks controller goal/initial_joint, gripper current_action and qacc_warmstart. Explicitly define fresh-controller reset; do not claim deterministic replay of missing hidden state.

success.formula: extent=abs(site_xmat @ site_size); lower=site_xpos-extent; lower.z-=.01; upper=site_xpos+extent; all(book_body_xpos>lower) AND all(book_body_xpos<upper). Strict comparisons; source AABB approximation, not oriented-box or volume containment.
success.synthetic_dataset_labels: create_dataset.py writes dones/rewards zeros and final1; never use as online success.

reset.nvidia_wrapper: seed optional -> ordinary OffScreenRenderEnv.reset; no benchmark initstate selection or warmup in that path.
reset.owned_private_profile: Pair selected original demo model_file XML with that demo init_state. Different from NVIDIA wrapper seed reset distribution; label explicitly.
reset.hdf5_temporal_alignment: states[t] pre-action, obs[t] after action. Raw derived pose at post-action time is one .002s integration stale; matched five original pose/axis-angle observations to <=1.8e-15 using original next state minus last Euler integration.

evaluation.wall_time: 20Hz denotes simulated controller cadence. Freeze wall latency and simulation-step timing separately; current113 component times are not a real-time control claim.
evaluation.prerequisite: Extend and qualify actual fullvision/text/action plan for152token task instruction, not just request/text helpers.

observation_stamps.finger_qpos: Post-integration direct qpos, as original observable.
observation_stamps.Coax_admission: Quaternion squared norm within 2^-20 of 1; component magnitude <= 2; output representable as F32. Task/object coordinate magnitude <= 1000 m, sizes in [0,1000] m, matrix component magnitude <= 1+2^-20. Additional bounded admission checks beyond the source equations.

source_control_reference_scope: Fresh Coax controller reset at restored grip-site pose, nominal source home and zero internal gripper target. Explicit owned reset profile, not a replay of unrecorded historical controller or qacc warmstart state.

SDK_clock_guard.scope: Plain F64 and integer logical SDK clock; not R13 compiler typed clocks, #bounded proof or wall deadlines.
SDK_clock_guard.failure: Unexpected effects or clock mismatch abort without a completed case ledger; partial SDK advancement is not rolled back.
SDK_clock_guard.first_two_episode_evidence: clock-qualification.json retrospectively checks existing traces; these episodes did not execute the new guard live.
